description: Canonical ValidationError (422) corpus. HTTP 422 surfaces as the SDK's ValidationError. The backend wraps every FastAPI 422 into the canonical envelope {error:'validation_error', message, request_id, details:[...]} via the global RequestValidationError handler. The route-level error code (e.g. ssrf_rejected) is carried in the 'error' field when the route raises HTTPException(422, {'error': '<code>'}).

cases.name: validation_error
cases.trigger: customers.create({}) (missing required fields) or any malformed request body.

cases.name: ssrf_rejected
cases.message: The webhook URL is not allowed (SSRF guard: private/link-local/cloud-metadata endpoints are rejected).
cases.parity_note: Under the local non-prod gate, loopback sinks 127.0.0.1/::1/localhost within ports 3101-3111 are accepted. The same ssrf_rejected code string is used in TS/Python/Go and matches the Partner surface.

cases.name: invalid_revocation_type
cases.message: The revocation type must be one of {capability_token, agent}.

cases.name: invalid_target_id
cases.message: The target_id must be a valid UUID.

cases.name: missing_reason
cases.message: A reason is required to suspend a customer.

cases.name: incomplete_attestation
cases.message: The attestation is incomplete; required evidence is missing.
cases.trigger: attestations.submit with missing required evidence fields.
